title: Decision: after the mailbox lock proved deaf (HTTP 403 on the relay's own comment), is the knock-author fence enough, or isolate mailboxes another way?
body:
domain:skills#1 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmPd7uRqHauEehGPr19

Filing gate ③: seat-directed (domain:skills#1, after the canary measurement 6897369511 and review record 6897706365 ③ on PR #34022). Follow-up of #33789.

## 维护者速读

- **现状:** #33789 要求两件事：信箱 PR 锁会话（外人写不进来）+ 读敲门只认车队机器人与维护者。第 2 件已落地（PR #33972）。第 1 件落地后实测：锁住后 GitHub 连车队中继自己的评论也拒（HTTP 403），锁了信箱就听不见敲门，所以 PR #34022 把锁撤掉了。
- **剩下的风险:** 外人仍能在信箱 PR 下留言。读敲门的工具会忽略它、不转述正文。但如果某个会话不走工具、直接读 PR 评论，就会读到外人的文字。
- **要您选:** 是否接受第 2 件单独兜底（推荐 A），还是另做隔离（B 或 C）。

## Today

- `record-recognisers.mjs` `readMailboxComment` counts a knock only when the author is `objectstack-fleet[bot]` or in `GOVERNED_APPROVERS`; any other author is listed as ignored, body unread (#33972, `bc6b7ffd`). `untrusted-text.md` and `seat-post-protocol.md` tell seats to read mailboxes through that reader, never raw.
- Locking was measured on mailbox #33915: lock read back `locked: true`, the relay App's comment answered `HTTP 403 — Unable to create comment because issue is locked`, and the take-back unlocked it (runs 43733466622 / 43733514690 / 43733552114). An App with write access cannot comment on a locked conversation, so a lock and a working mailbox cannot coexist on GitHub. PR #34022 removes the lock and pins that no lock op returns without a new measurement.
- The card's item 3 (a knock's session must match the named seat) is split to #34013.

## Decision needed (maintainer)

- **A. Accept the author fence as the mailbox defence (recommended).** No further change. An outsider's comment on a mailbox is noise the reader drops; the residual is a session that bypasses the reader, which the skill text already forbids. #33789 closes when #34022 lands; #34013 hardens the fence further.
- **B. Repository interaction limit.** Set the repo's interaction limit to collaborators only (GitHub caps it at 6 months, renewable). Outsiders could no longer comment anywhere in the repo, including on public issues and PRs, so it also closes the product's public intake that #33789 item 4 kept open. A maintainer-only setting; no code.
- **C. Move mailboxes to a private repository.** Mailbox PRs live in a private org repo the relay can write to; outsiders cannot read or write them. Cost: `mailbox-open`, the doorbell reader, seat posts and the relay allowlist all learn a second repo; a skills-lane card of size M–L.

Why A: the threat #33789 named was an outsider's knock being acted on, and item 2 closes exactly that at the one reader every seat uses; B costs the public intake, and C buys isolation of text that is already dropped unread. Pick C if you want mailbox text unreachable even by a session that ignores the skill.

Prior rulings read: #33789 body item 4 ("issues opened by outsiders … is the product's public intake and is not locked"), which B would reverse. No ⛔ line requires mailboxes to be private.

## Reader

domain:skills (seat 1) for any follow-up; B is a maintainer setting with no card.
